shared: regulation of antigen processing and presentation of peptide antigen
Processing of antigen in germinal center B cells
antigen processing and presentation of exogenous peptide antigen via MHC class II
peptide antigen assembly with MHC class II protein complex
antigen processing and presentation, endogenous lipid antigen via MHC class Ib
regulation of antigen processing and presentation of peptide or polysaccharide antigen via MHC class II
negative regulation of antigen processing and presentation

reading_1.theme: Antigen processing and presentation by MHC class II and CD1
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover loading and presenting peptide antigens on MHC class II, and lipid antigens on CD1/MHC Ib, by professional antigen-presenting cells. They are read here in the context of dendritic-cell/monocyte receptor programmes and TLR7 sensing.

reading_2.theme: Antigen processing and MHC presentation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are MHC class II and lipid antigen processing and presentation and their regulation, framed as the core function of professional antigen-presenting cells such as dendritic cells and monocytes.

shared: obsolete regulation of cell proliferation involved in kidney development
mesenchymal stem cell maintenance involved in nephron morphogenesis
negative regulation of apoptotic process involved in development
negative regulation of mesenchymal cell apoptotic process
negative regulation of cell proliferation involved in kidney development

reading_1.theme: Regulation of kidney development and nephron growth
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the controls on kidney size and growth, setting the balance of nephron progenitor mesenchyme maintenance, proliferation and apoptosis, which feed the metanephric tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct formation in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Kidney development: nephron progenitor and growth control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are control of nephron progenitor maintenance, proliferation, survival and kidney size, the growth-regulating core of metanephric development whose segments form tubules and ducts.

shared: regulation of retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi

reading_1.theme: Endosome-Golgi retrograde and recycling transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover bidirectional endosome-Golgi transport and Golgi protein retention. This is the sorting route within wider endosomal recycling, receptor return to the plasma membrane and lysosomal hydrolase delivery.

reading_2.theme: Endosome-Golgi retrograde trafficking and membrane recycling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover retrograde transport from endosomes to the Golgi and retention of proteins in the Golgi. This is the sorting hub that returns receptors and machinery, linked to recycling to the plasma membrane and to delivery of lysosomal cargo.

shared: SEMA3A-Plexin repulsion signaling by inhibiting Integrin adhesion
positive regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance

reading_1.theme: Semaphorin and netrin axon guidance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame Sema3A-plexin and netrin repulsive and attractive signalling (via CRMPs, PAK and integrin inhibition) as the guidance cues that steer axon extension toward target innervation.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are semaphorin-plexin and netrin signalling for axon extension and repulsion, framed as two of several guidance systems (with Slit-Robo and ephrins) that steer growth cones via Rho GTPases.

shared: RHO GTPases Activate WASPs and WAVEs
positive regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation

reading_1.theme: Rho-family GTPase signalling in actin cytoskeleton remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe RAC3 and Rho GTPase activation of WASP/WAVE, Arp2/3 and formins to build lamellipodia, framed here as the actin-nucleation effector output of the many Rho/Rac/CDC42 GTPase cycles in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: Rho GTPase-driven actin remodelling for cell motility
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the Rac/Rho GTPase-to-Arp2/3 and formin nucleation signals that build lamellipodia, framed as the upstream drivers of leading-edge actin dynamics, migration and macropinocytosis.

shared: co-transcriptional mRNA 3'-end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway

reading_1.theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and translation-coupled mRNA surveillance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are mRNA cleavage and polyadenylation, framed as the 3'-end formation that defines where translation terminates and so feeds nonsense-mediated and non-stop decay surveillance.

reading_2.theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and translation-coupled mRNA surveillance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cleavage and polyadenylation defining mature mRNA 3' ends, framed by how translation termination and nonsense/non-stop decay judge and degrade mRNAs.

shared: protection from non-homologous end joining at telomere
double-strand break repair via break-induced replication

reading_1.theme: Telomere maintenance via replication and recombination repair
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover telomere replication, capping, t-loop/D-loop handling and break-induced replication, framed as telomere-specific uses of the helicase, strand-invasion and DSB repair machinery.

reading_2.theme: Telomere maintenance and recombination-based DNA repair
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are telomere-specific DNA transactions, covering capping and protection from NHEJ, D-loop and t-circle handling, recombination-based (ALT) and replication-based telomere maintenance, and break-induced replication, set within homologous recombination and replication-stress repair.

shared: negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
collateral sprouting in absence of injury

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance, repulsion and collateral sprouting
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe axon chemorepulsion and collateral sprouting in dorsal root ganglion neurons, framed as Sema3A-driven guidance and branching during peripheral nerve wiring.

reading_2.theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and sprouting
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are axonal behaviours (chemorepulsion, inhibited extension, collateral sprouting) and dorsal root ganglion development, framed as the developmental outcomes of netrin signalling.

shared: Negative regulation of TCF-dependent signaling by DVL-interacting proteins

reading_1.theme: Axial mesoderm and neural plate formation in early embryo
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe notochord/axial mesoderm formation, apical constriction and Wnt-TCF modulation, framed here as the midline organiser tissue that patterns the overlying neural plate, floor plate and neural fold.

reading_2.theme: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension in axis formation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are notochord and axial mesoderm morphogenesis, apical constriction and dampening of canonical Wnt/TCF signalling, framed as the tissue-shaping outcomes driven by non-canonical Wnt/PCP and Hedgehog signalling.

shared: CREB1 phosphorylation through the activation of CaMKII/CaMKK/CaMKIV cascasde
Activation of AMPK downstream of NMDARs

reading_1.theme: NMDA receptor calcium signalling in synaptic plasticity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the Ca2+-activated CaMKK/CaMKIV/CaMKII and AMPK kinase relays that turn NMDA-receptor calcium influx into CREB phosphorylation and energy sensing, i.e. the nuclear, transcriptional output arm of glutamatergic long-term potentiation.

reading_2.theme: NMDA receptor calcium signalling and synaptic plasticity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Ca2+/calmodulin kinase cascades (CaMKII/CaMKK/CaMKIV to CREB and AMPK), framed here as the downstream signalling of NMDA-receptor calcium influx that couples glutamatergic activity to long-term potentiation.

shared: IRF3-mediated induction of type I IFN
negative regulation of cGAS/STING signaling pathway
positive regulation of type I interferon-mediated signaling pathway
IRF3 mediated activation of type 1 IFN
positive regulation of defense response to virus by host

reading_1.theme: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover IRF3-driven type I interferon induction downstream of cGAS-STING, together with its restraint. They sit alongside RIG-I/MDA5 RNA sensing and IFN-alpha antiviral effector responses.

reading_2.theme: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover IRF3-driven type I IFN induction and its cGAS/STING limits, framed as the output of RIG-I/MDA5 RNA sensing that culminates in OAS and interferon antiviral effects.

shared: Sealing of the nuclear envelope (NE) by ESCRT-III

reading_1.theme: Mitotic cell division from nuclear envelope to cytokinesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover nuclear envelope breakdown, ESCRT-III resealing and reassembly, and midbody abscission. These are the membrane-remodelling bookends of mitosis, framing the chromosome cohesion, condensation and spindle machinery in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic nuclear envelope dynamics and cell division
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation, ESCRT-III sealing and abscission, framed as the membrane remodelling events of mitosis alongside chromosome condensation, cohesion and spindle control.

shared: Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) independent of the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)
nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, no-go decay
Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) enhanced by the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)
PELO:HBS1L and ABCE1 dissociate a ribosome on a non-stop mRNA

reading_1.theme: Cytoplasmic mRNA translation and translational quality control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the end of translation and its surveillance, with termination, nonsense-mediated, non-stop and no-go decay and eEF2 diphthamide modification, complemented by initiation, elongation and ribosome rescue in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: mRNA translation initiation, termination and quality control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are translation termination and ribosome/mRNA surveillance at stop codons and stalls (NMD, no-go, non-stop decay), the terminal and quality-control end of the translation cycle that begins with initiation.

shared: Assembly of active LPL and LIPC lipase complexes
regulation of very-low-density lipoprotein particle clearance

reading_1.theme: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are assembly, lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance of triglyceride-rich lipoproteins (chylomicrons, VLDL), framed as the plasma delivery of absorbed and hepatic lipid.

reading_2.theme: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame VLDL and chylomicron assembly, lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance as the core plasma transport of triglycerides, regulated by LXR-driven lipogenesis and lipolysis.

shared: Signaling by cytosolic FGFR1 fusion mutants
FLT3 signaling through SRC family kinases
STAT5 activation downstream of FLT3 ITD mutants

reading_1.theme: FLT3 and cytokine receptor signalling to STAT5 in leukemia
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover FLT3 (including fusion and ITD mutants) signalling through SRC kinases and STAT5 with CBL negative regulation, framed as the oncogenic driver signalling targeted by TKIs, alongside erythropoietin receptor signalling.

reading_2.theme: FLT3 signalling, oncogenic mutants and TKI resistance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are FLT3 receptor tyrosine kinase signalling, its STAT5/SRC outputs, CBL-mediated negative regulation and oncogenic FLT3-ITD/fusion activation, framed here as the leukemogenic signal targeted by tyrosine kinase inhibitors to which resistant mutants arise.

shared: regulation of telomere maintenance in response to DNA damage

reading_1.theme: Replication stress response and DNA topology
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe changes in DNA topology and fork reversal during replication, framed as responses to replication stress (hydroxyurea, camptothecin, R-loops, DNA-protein crosslinks) that preserve genome stability.

reading_2.theme: Telomere maintenance and DNA structural transactions
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are DNA topology and geometry changes, replication fork reversal and regulation of strand elongation, framed as the DNA mechanics used for telomere replication and recombination-based telomere maintenance.

shared: Defective SLC35A1 in sialic acid metabolism causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)
Defective transport by SLC35A1 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2F (CDG2F)
Defective SLC35C1 causes congenital disorder of glycosylation 2C (CDG2C)

reading_1.theme: Nucleotide-sugar transport and congenital glycosylation disorders
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are defects of the Golgi CMP-sialic acid and GDP-fucose transporters causing CDG, framed as failures of nucleotide-sugar supply to the Golgi for glycosylation.

reading_2.theme: Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporter defects in glycosylation disorders
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are SLC35A1/SLC35C1 defects causing CDG2F and CDG2C, framed as failures of the Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport needed for glycosylation.

reading_1.theme: Glutamate and glutamine nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate interconversions and ammonium handling, framed as cellular nitrogen assimilation and disposal coupled to the malate-aspartate shuttle.

reading_2.theme: Ammonia detoxification through glutamate/glutamine and the urea cycle
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate/glutamine and aspartate metabolism with ammonium homeostasis, framed here as the nitrogen-carrying input to the urea cycle, supplying ammonia and aspartate for arginine/citrulline/ornithine metabolism whose enzyme defects cause hyperammonaemia.

shared: Defective SLC11A2 causes hypochromic microcytic anemia, with iron overload 1 (AHMIO1)
Erythrocytes take up oxygen and release carbon dioxide
Defective RHAG causes regulator type Rh-null hemolytic anemia (RHN)
regulation of iron ion transmembrane transport
iron ion import across plasma membrane
Erythrocytes take up carbon dioxide and release oxygen

reading_1.theme: Erythrocyte gas transport, iron and heme homeostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are erythrocyte and iron-handling membrane transport (O2/CO2 exchange, Rh ammonium transport, transferrin and iron uptake/export, heme scavenging), the supply side that supports heme biosynthesis and erythropoiesis.

reading_2.theme: Erythrocyte iron, heme and gas transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe red cell and systemic transport of iron, heme, oxygen, CO2 and ammonium (transferrin, ferroportin, Rh proteins) and their anemias, framed as the transport side of erythropoiesis and heme biosynthesis.

shared: negative regulation of neuron projection regeneration
positive regulation of neuron projection regeneration

reading_1.theme: Axon regeneration and its inhibition after nerve injury
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover injury-induced axon sprouting, peripheral axon regeneration and RhoA-mediated growth inhibition, framed as the neuronal injury response balanced by p75NTR, ceramide and JNK growth-versus-death signalling.

reading_2.theme: Axon regeneration, sprouting and cytoskeletal control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are injury-induced axon regeneration and sprouting with RhoA-mediated growth inhibition, framed within neuronal cytoskeletal control of axon growth, calibre and branching.

shared: regulation of mitochondrial ATP synthesis coupled electron transport
regulation of mitochondrial electron transport, NADH to ubiquinone
positive regulation of nucleotide biosynthetic process
negative regulation of reactive oxygen species biosynthetic process
negative regulation of cellular response to oxidative stress

reading_1.theme: Regulation of mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation and ROS
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are tuning of the electron transport chain, ATP synthesis and respiration while limiting ROS, framed as mitochondrial bioenergetic control that shapes cell stress, drug and hypoxia responses and apoptosis.

reading_2.theme: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative stress
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are direct control of oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP synthesis and ROS output, framed as the bioenergetic set point that governs cellular stress responses to hypoxia, drugs and apoptotic cues.

reading_1.theme: Vitamin B1/B2 and related nutrient transport and metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover uptake of thiamine and riboflavin and their conversion into coenzymes (TPP, FMN/FAD). Here they are part of micronutrient and cofactor supply, together with carnitine and choline handling and flavin-dependent FMO oxidation.

reading_2.theme: Water-soluble vitamin and nutrient metabolism: B1, B2, carnitine, choline
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe thiamine and riboflavin uptake and metabolism, framed alongside carnitine and choline handling and the flavin-dependent FMO enzymes as related cofactor and nutrient metabolism.

reading_1.theme: Amino acid catabolism through glyoxylate and glycine metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover generic L-amino acid and amide catabolic/metabolic processes. Here they are the broad organic-acid degradation that converges on glyoxylate and glycine interconversion, including breakdown of non-proteinogenic amino acids.

reading_2.theme: Amino acid catabolism (threonine)
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are generic amino acid and amide catabolism, framed concretely as threonine degradation.

shared: positive regulation of attachment of mitotic spindle microtubules to kinetochore

reading_1.theme: Anaphase spindle midzone and cytokinesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe spindle midzone assembly, spindle elongation and kinetochore attachment, framed as the mitotic spindle events that position and drive Rho GTPase-dependent cytokinesis.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic spindle assembly, checkpoint and segregation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are spindle midzone assembly, spindle elongation and kinetochore attachment, framed as spindle mechanics of chromosome segregation under spindle-checkpoint and PLK1 control.

shared: SLBP Dependent Processing of Replication-Dependent Histone Pre-mRNAs
SLBP independent Processing of Histone Pre-mRNAs
mRNA 3'-end processing by stem-loop binding and cleavage

reading_1.theme: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and transcription termination
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame the stem-loop (SLBP) processing and turnover of replication-dependent histone mRNAs as the specialized non-polyadenylated branch of the general 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation and Pol II termination machinery.

reading_2.theme: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are 3'-end processing and termination of replication-dependent histone pre-mRNAs, the maturation step preceding nuclear export of mature mRNAs.

shared: enriched in naive and memory B cells

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes lymphocyte activation within organised lymphoid tissue, the process by which antigen-experienced B and T cells are positioned, co-stimulated and driven toward antibody secretion. It underlies germinal centre reactions and the generation of plasma cells, and its components are the surface markers used to identify activated and malignant lymphoid cells.

reading_1.theme: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are B cell transcriptional signatures and lymphoid activation modules that mark the B lineage, read here as the cellular starting point for germinal-centre maturation into memory B cells and immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells.

reading_2.theme: B cell identity and differentiation to plasma cells
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover B-cell transcriptional module signatures marking the naive/memory B lymphocyte compartment and lymphoid activation. This is the starting compartment that germinal centre differentiation turns into memory B cells and immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells.

shared: negative regulation of respiratory burst involved in inflammatory response
regulation of killing of cells of another organism

[untitled BTM module] These genes mark the differentiated tissue macrophage and microglial state, the resident phagocyte programme that clears debris and dying cells, handles iron and heme, and shapes local immune tone. Fc receptor gamma chain and the Tec kinase BTK couple immunoglobulin and immune-complex recognition to phagocytosis, while CYBB encodes the NADPH oxidase catalytic subunit gp91phox that generates the respiratory burst; its loss causes chronic granulomatous disease with recurrent bacterial and fungal infection.
positive regulation of reactive oxygen species biosynthetic process
Events associated with phagocytolytic activity of PMN cells
positive regulation of defense response to bacterium

reading_1.theme: Phagocyte antimicrobial killing and host-pathogen interaction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are phagocyte effector killing: NADPH-oxidase respiratory burst, neutrophil degranulation and cytotoxicity by neutrophils and macrophages. Here they form the host side of antibacterial and antifungal defence, alongside antimicrobial peptides, and are the target of subversion by pathogens such as Mtb and Listeria.

reading_2.theme: Phagocyte antimicrobial killing and host-pathogen interaction
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the phagocyte microbicidal effector arm: the NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and ROS, neutrophil degranulation and cytotoxicity against bacteria and fungi. Antimicrobial peptides complement this arm, and pathogen evasion strategies (blocking phagosome acidification, metal sequestration and others) counter it.

shared: SLBP independent Processing of Histone Pre-mRNAs
co-transcriptional mRNA 3'-end processing, cleavage and polyadenylation pathway
SLBP Dependent Processing of Replication-Dependent Histone Pre-mRNAs
positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome
mRNA 3'-end processing by stem-loop binding and cleavage

reading_1.theme: mRNA 3'-end processing, polyadenylation and decay
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the nuclear birth of the mRNA 3' end (cleavage, polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing, Pol II termination), read here as the step that sets up the poly(A) tail and 3' end that the cytoplasmic deadenylation, decapping and decay machinery later acts on.

reading_2.theme: Nuclear RNA processing: 3'-end formation, splicing and decay
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are pre-mRNA 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing and Pol II termination, forming the 3'-end maturation step within the broader nuclear splicing, snRNA and RNA surveillance machinery.

shared: negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
collateral sprouting in absence of injury

reading_1.theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and collateral branching
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are axon chemorepulsion, limits on axon extension and collateral sprouting in sensory (DRG) neurons, framed as how netrin guidance cues shape axon growth and branching.

reading_2.theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and sprouting
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are axonal behaviours (chemorepulsion, inhibited extension, collateral sprouting) and dorsal root ganglion development, framed as the developmental outcomes of netrin signalling.

shared: Sealing of the nuclear envelope (NE) by ESCRT-III

reading_1.theme: Mitotic nuclear envelope dynamics and cell division
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation, ESCRT-III sealing and abscission, framed as the membrane remodelling events of mitosis alongside chromosome condensation, cohesion and spindle control.

reading_2.theme: Nuclear envelope breakdown and reassembly in mitosis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are nuclear envelope disassembly, ESCRT-III resealing and abscission, framed as mitotic nuclear envelope remodeling including nuclear pore disassembly and reformation.

shared: Phosphorylation of CD3 and TCR zeta chains
Translocation of ZAP-70 to Immunological synapse
negative regulation of T cell receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: Lymphocyte antigen-receptor signalling and co-stimulation/co-inhibition
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover proximal TCR signalling and its tuning by CD28 co-stimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition. This is the T-cell instance of setting antigen-receptor activation thresholds, paralleled by BCR signalling in B cells.

reading_2.theme: Lymphocyte antigen-receptor signalling, costimulation and inhibition
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the T cell side of antigen-receptor activation: CD3/ZAP-70 proximal signalling, CD28 costimulation, and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition. This runs parallel to BCR signalling and to inhibitory receptor brakes on leukocyte activation.

shared: Defective SLC5A1 causes congenital glucose/galactose malabsorption (GGM)

reading_1.theme: SLC transporter-mediated epithelial nutrient transport and its disorders
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the carbohydrate arm of epithelial solute handling, covering dietary sugar digestion, intestinal and renal hexose uptake and the SGLT/GLUT defect disorders, alongside the amino acid, urate and organic anion carriers.

reading_2.theme: Epithelial nutrient transport: hexoses and amino acids
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe intestinal digestion and absorption of dietary sugars and hexose transport by SLC2/SLC5 carriers and their disorders, framed as one part of epithelial solute transport in gut and kidney together with amino acid and organic anion carriers.

shared: RUNX2 regulates genes involved in differentiation of myeloid cells
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in WNT signaling
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in differentiation of myeloid cells
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in BCR signaling
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in interleukin signaling

reading_1.theme: RUNX-driven transcriptional control of myeloid granulopoiesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared RUNX1/RUNX2/RUNX3 transcriptional programmes act as the master transcriptional regulators of myeloid and neutrophil lineage commitment that G-CSF signalling and granulopoietic factors carry forward.

reading_2.theme: RUNX-regulated transcription in myeloid and granulocyte differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe RUNX1/2/3 transcriptional programmes, framed as master regulators of myeloid progenitor commitment and granulopoiesis together with G-CSF signalling.

shared: protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane
protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe insertion of proteins into the inner mitochondrial membrane and assembly of complexes I and III, the biogenesis step that builds the electron transport chain for oxidative phosphorylation.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are inner-membrane protein insertion and assembly of complexes I and III, framed as the building of the electron transport chain that drives oxidative phosphorylation.

shared: positive regulation of B cell differentiation

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes lymphocyte activation within organised lymphoid tissue, the process by which antigen-experienced B and T cells are positioned, co-stimulated and driven toward antibody secretion. It underlies germinal centre reactions and the generation of plasma cells, and its components are the surface markers used to identify activated and malignant lymphoid cells.
positive regulation of B cell proliferation
enriched in naive and memory B cells
RUNX1 regulates transcription of genes involved in BCR signaling
B cell proliferation involved in immune response
positive regulation of B cell receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: B cell development, activation and plasma cell differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell identity, BCR signalling, proliferation and differentiation, framed as the core lymphocyte programme driving germinal centre, memory and plasma cell responses.

reading_2.theme: B cell activation and humoral immune differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell identity, BCR signalling, proliferation and differentiation, framed as the activation base from which germinal centre, plasma cell and memory B responses with T follicular help arise.

reading_1.theme: Germinal centre B cell maturation into plasma and memory cells
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways denote germinal centre B differentiation with T follicular helper support and plasma cell output, framed within broad B cell identity, activation, co-stimulation (ICOS, CD27) and memory programmes.

reading_2.theme: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the differentiation path of antigen-activated B cells with T follicular helper help, from naive and memory B cells through germinal centre B cells to immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells, within the wider B cell identity, signalling and homeostasis programme.

reading_1.theme: Xenobiotic and drug metabolism and detoxification
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover phase I/II biotransformation of toxins, alcohols and steroids (CYP oxidation, sulfonation, aflatoxin activation). This is the general detoxification machinery that also governs drug ADME.

reading_2.theme: Xenobiotic and drug metabolism (phase I/II detoxification)
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the core phase I oxidation (cytochromes, alcohol oxidation) and phase II sulfonation that detoxify toxins, mycotoxins, ethanol and steroids. Here this is the generic detoxification machinery that drug ADME, CYP/FMO reactions and conjugations apply.

shared: tRNA aminoacylation for mitochondrial protein translation
aminoacyl-tRNA metabolism involved in translational fidelity

reading_1.theme: tRNA aminoacylation and modification for translational fidelity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging plus anticodon wobble modifications, framed as the core mechanisms guaranteeing accurate decoding.

reading_2.theme: tRNA charging, modification and translational fidelity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and wobble-position tRNA modifications, framed here as the tRNA side of translational accuracy, complemented by wybutosine and translation-factor modifications (diphthamide, hypusine, hydroxylation).

shared: positive regulation of type I interferon-mediated signaling pathway
negative regulation of cGAS/STING signaling pathway
positive regulation of defense response to virus by host
IRF3-mediated induction of type I IFN
IRF3 mediated activation of type 1 IFN

reading_1.theme: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover IRF3-driven type I IFN induction and its cGAS/STING limits, framed as the output of RIG-I/MDA5 RNA sensing that culminates in OAS and interferon antiviral effects.

reading_2.theme: STING/IRF3 type I interferon induction and its restraint
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe IRF3-driven type I interferon induction and its cGAS-STING regulation, framed as antiviral innate sensing subject to negative feedback on interferon-beta.

shared: positive regulation of myeloid leukocyte mediated immunity

reading_1.theme: Neutrophil and monocyte innate immune activation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame myeloid effector functions, neutrophil degranulation and complement-receptor signalling, as the output of innate myeloid activation defined by monocyte and neutrophil signatures.

reading_2.theme: Neutrophil activation, degranulation and antimicrobial response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover neutrophil degranulation and myeloid effector activation via complement receptors, framed as the deployment of the granule antimicrobial arsenal by recruited, formyl-peptide-stimulated neutrophils.

shared: positive regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

reading_1.theme: snRNP biogenesis and pre-mRNA processing and export
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover snRNP assembly, snRNA cap hypermethylation and transport and splicing, framed as the spliceosome machinery within broader mRNA processing, 3'-end formation and nuclear export.

reading_2.theme: Spliceosome assembly, pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear RNA surveillance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe biogenesis of the splicing machinery itself (snRNA cap hypermethylation, snRNA transport, snRNP assembly), framed as supplying the spliceosome that carries out major/minor splicing alongside exosome-driven nuclear RNA surveillance and decay.

reading_1.theme: Glutamate-centred amino acid and nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover interconversion of glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and alpha-ketoglutarate as the nitrogen-handling hub. Here this hub extends towards arginine/citrulline and aspartate-family amino acid metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover the central glutamate/glutamine/aspartate interconversions and alpha-ketoglutarate transport. Here they are the nitrogen-handling hub that extends to arginine and citrulline (urea-cycle-adjacent) metabolism.

shared: establishment of protein localization to chromatin

reading_1.theme: Chromatin assembly and histone acetylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover nucleosome assembly, histone/protein acetylation and repair-coupled chromatin remodelling, framed as chromatin organization regulating replication, repair and senescence-associated heterochromatin.

reading_2.theme: Epigenetic chromatin regulation by histone modification and remodelling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are histone acetylation, nucleosome assembly and repair/replication-coupled chromatin remodelling, which this theme frames as the acetylation-and-assembly layer of a broader epigenetic system that also includes histone/DNA methylation, BAF/NuRD/PRC2 complexes, heterochromatin silencing and imprinting.

reading_1.theme: Glycerophospholipid biosynthesis and acyl-chain remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the de novo synthesis routes for PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin via CDP-choline and CDP-diacylglycerol, which the theme frames as the starting point for Lands-cycle remodelling, hydrolysis and lipid transfer.

reading_2.theme: Glycerophospholipid biosynthesis and acyl-chain remodeling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are de novo synthesis and transfer of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin, complemented by Lands-cycle acyl-chain remodeling and phospholipid hydrolysis.

reading_1.theme: RNA modification and ribosome biogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the mitochondrial branch of RNA modification and ribosome assembly, with mito-mRNA and rRNA modification, mitoribosome subunit assembly and translation, paralleled by cytosolic/nucleolar rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation and pseudouridylation.

reading_2.theme: RNA modification in ribosome and translation machinery biogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the mitochondrial instance of the theme: rRNA/mRNA modification and mitoribosome subunit assembly enabling mitochondrial translation, set against the broader nuclear-cytosolic tRNA, rRNA and snRNA modification machinery.

shared: positive regulation of myeloid leukocyte mediated immunity

reading_1.theme: Monocyte inflammatory activation and TLR regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the inflammatory effector state of monocytes and myeloid cells. The additional pathways show this state as driven by TLR/MyD88 and CD40 signalling, with negative feedback and changes in antigen presentation.

reading_2.theme: Myeloid innate inflammatory activation and TLR regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the generic monocyte-driven inflammatory and myeloid effector response, which the theme places under control of TLR, CD40 and antigen-presentation signalling in dendritic cells and monocytes.

shared: positive regulation of cGAS/STING signaling pathway
positive regulation of dendritic cell cytokine production
cyclic-GMP-AMP transmembrane import across plasma membrane

reading_1.theme: Innate cytosolic DNA sensing and dendritic cell cytokines
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cGAS-STING activation, including cGAMP import, driving myeloid dendritic cell cytokine production, framed here as innate host defence alongside inflammasome, GBP, chemokine (CCL5) and anti-protozoan responses.

reading_2.theme: cGAS-STING sensing and dendritic cell cytokine responses
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover STING pathway activation, including import of extracellular cGAMP, and the resulting cytokine production by myeloid dendritic cells. Here this is innate antimicrobial signalling linked to CCL5 chemokine regulation, GBP-mediated defense and inflammasome activity.

reading_1.theme: Histone and protein methylation and demethylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe histone demethylation, lysine dimethylation and CHD1/2 chromatin remodelling that reads H3K4 methylation, framed here as the chromatin-centred side of a protein methylation system that also targets arginines and non-histone proteins like p53 and RUNX1.

reading_2.theme: Histone modification and chromatin remodelling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are histone lysine methylation and demethylation plus CHD1/2 remodellers, framed as writers, erasers and remodellers setting epigenetic chromatin state alongside NuRD, HDACs and KMT complexes.

shared: Transport of glycerol from adipocytes to the liver by Aquaporins

reading_1.theme: Aquaporin and vasopressin-regulated water balance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are aquaglyceroporin and urea channel permeation of glycerol and urea, the solute-transport side of aquaporins read alongside vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption.

reading_2.theme: Aquaporin water and solute transport in renal water homeostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover aquaglyceroporin and urea channel transport of small neutral solutes (glycerol, urea). They sit beside vasopressin-regulated aquaporin water reabsorption in the kidney, where urea transport contributes to urine concentration.

shared: aminoacyl-tRNA metabolism involved in translational fidelity
tRNA aminoacylation for mitochondrial protein translation

reading_1.theme: tRNA aminoacylation and modification for translational fidelity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging plus anticodon wobble modifications, framed as the core mechanisms guaranteeing accurate decoding.

reading_2.theme: tRNA charging and modification for translational fidelity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and wobble-position modification. Here they act as the machinery for accurate codon decoding, alongside t6A modification and maintenance of translational fidelity.

reading_1.theme: N-glycan processing and oligosaccharide/amino-sugar metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glycoside trimming and catabolism, ER N-glycan processing (MOGS, MAN1B1 defects) and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown, framed here within broader sugar and amino-sugar metabolism supplying glycan building blocks.

reading_2.theme: N-glycan processing and amino sugar/mannose metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are glycosidase-mediated N-glycan trimming in the ER and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown (with their CDG/MRT defects), framed as glycan processing and turnover that feeds monosaccharide metabolism.

shared: positive regulation of type II interferon production

reading_1.theme: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 cytokine immunity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are production of IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF, the cytokine signals by which activated dendritic cells and T cells drive Th1 responses and memory T cell differentiation.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 immune activation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the cytokine outputs (IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF) produced by activated dendritic cells and T cells, framed as the signals that polarize T cells towards a Th1 response.

shared: establishment of mitotic sister chromatid cohesion

reading_1.theme: Cohesin and condensin-mediated chromosome organization
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion with cohesin-mediated chromatin looping, the cohesion arm of chromosome architecture complementing condensin-driven chromosome condensation and centromere assembly.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic chromosome organisation by cohesin and condensin
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe cohesin loading, cohesion establishment and chromatin looping, framed as the cohesion side of chromosome structuring that is complemented by condensin-driven chromosome condensation.

shared: negative regulation of microglial cell activation
negative regulation of long-term synaptic potentiation
positive regulation of microglial cell migration
microglial cell activation involved in immune response

reading_1.theme: Microglial neuroinflammation in amyloid neurodegeneration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe microglial activation, proliferation and cytotoxicity in response to amyloid-beta, with neuronal death and impaired synaptic plasticity, framed as glial neuroinflammation in Alzheimer-type pathology.

reading_2.theme: Microglial neuroinflammation in amyloid-associated neurodegeneration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe microglial activation, migration, proliferation and cytotoxicity in response to amyloid-beta, framed as the neuroinflammatory driver of hippocampal neuron death and synaptic impairment.

shared: SEMA3A-Plexin repulsion signaling by inhibiting Integrin adhesion

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe ephrin and Sema3A repulsion with growth cone collapse and fasciculation, framed as the repulsive core of a broader guidance system including Slit/Robo, netrin, L1 and Rho GTPase cytoskeletal control.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance by semaphorin and ephrin repulsion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe Sema3A and ephrin repulsive signalling, growth cone collapse and fasciculation, framed as neural wiring that extends into synapse pruning and neuron remodelling.

shared: regulation of secondary heart field cardioblast proliferation
cardiac neural crest cell migration involved in outflow tract morphogenesis
embryonic heart tube left/right pattern formation
TFAP2 (AP-2) family regulates transcription of other transcription factors
apoptotic process involved in heart morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Embryonic heart morphogenesis and outflow tract development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover heart tube patterning, second heart field and cardiac neural crest contributions, ventricle formation, and outflow tract septation with great artery morphogenesis. This is the structural morphogenesis that atrioventricular and conduction system development extend.

reading_2.theme: Embryonic heart morphogenesis: chambers, septa, valves and outflow tract
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame the early cardiogenic programme (heart tube looping, second heart field specification, neural-crest-driven outflow tract and great-artery patterning, ventricle formation) that the additional endocardial cushion, valve and septation processes then complete.

shared: positive regulation of glomerular mesangial cell proliferation

reading_1.theme: Metanephric nephron and glomerulus development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are glomerulus formation (mesangial, endothelial and epithelial development and vascularisation), the filtering unit within nephron and tubule segment development.

reading_2.theme: Glomerulus development and filtration barrier function
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover development of the glomerular mesangial, endothelial and epithelial compartments and vasculature, framed as building the filtration unit whose podocyte barrier and filtration function the additional pathways describe.

shared: regulation of short-term neuronal synaptic plasticity

reading_1.theme: AMPA receptor trafficking in excitatory synaptic plasticity
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and short-term plasticity at glutamatergic synapses, framed as the synaptic mechanism underlying simple learning.

reading_2.theme: AMPA receptor clustering and excitatory synaptic plasticity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover postsynaptic diffusion-trapping, clustering and regulation of AMPA receptors, which set the strength of excitatory transmission. Here this is the substrate of synaptic plasticity and learning.

shared: Signaling by CSF1 (M-CSF) in myeloid cells
regulation of response to macrophage colony-stimulating factor

reading_1.theme: M-CSF signalling in macrophage and myeloid differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are CSF1 receptor and related interleukin receptor signalling driving macrophage proliferation, framed as the cytokine trigger for monocyte, macrophage and dendritic-cell differentiation alongside GM-CSF and G-CSF.

reading_2.theme: M-CSF signalling in monocyte-macrophage development
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are CSF1/M-CSF receptor and related interleukin signalling that drives macrophage proliferation and survival, the growth-factor input into monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell differentiation.

mammary gland branching involved in pregnancy

Developmental Lineage of Mammary Gland Luminal Epithelial Cells
Developmental Lineage of Mammary Stem Cells
epithelial cell differentiation involved in prostate gland development
regulation of branching involved in prostate gland morphogenesis
epithelial cell proliferation involved in mammary gland duct elongation
positive regulation of mammary gland epithelial cell proliferation
negative regulation of morphogenesis of an epithelium
Developmental Lineage of Mammary Gland Alveolar Cells

reading_1.theme: Branching morphogenesis of glandular epithelia
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe mammary and prostate gland epithelial development, differentiation and branching, framed as instances of epithelial-mesenchymal branching morphogenesis shared with lung, salivary and other glands.

reading_2.theme: Glandular and reproductive organ epithelial development
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are mammary and prostate gland branching and epithelial differentiation, framed as glandular organogenesis within reproductive, pancreatic and endocrine organ development.
